stem:
Meera's teacher asks the class why Earth is able to support living things, while the Moon cannot.

Which statement gives the correct reason?

options.text: Earth supports life only because it has water, so no other conditions matter
Earth supports life because air, water, soil, food and shelter are linked together in a thin surface layer where living things exist
Earth supports life only because it is the largest rocky planet
Earth supports life only because it shines brightly in the night sky

teacher.key_rationale: Life on Earth depends on many linked life-supporting conditions (air, water, soil, food, shelter) in the biosphere, not on any single feature; A, C and D each reduce the cause to one irrelevant or insufficient feature. Key recalculated: B.
